title: Design System: Say My Day Presentation

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Opacity .65 to 1 and translateY(10px) to zero.

motion.name: bar-in
motion.purpose: Metric fill from zero to the supplied fill.

components.name: Primary Action

components.name: Text Action
components.css: .ds-text{font-family:var(--font,Day,-apple-system,"Apple SD Gothic Neo",sans-serif);background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#171918);border:0;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding:12px 0;font-size:24px;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer}.ds-text:hover{opacity:.65}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-text:focus-visible,.ds-tabs button:focus-visible,.ds-segment button:focus-visible,.ds-select:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69785e;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Journey Tabs
components.description: Static visual excerpt of selected journey tabs; runtime supplies tab interaction.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d3d4cc);gap:0}.ds-tabs button{font-family:var(--font,Day,-apple-system,"Apple SD Gothic Neo",sans-serif);border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#62675f);font-size:25px;font-weight:650;padding:13px 24px 17px;position:relative;min-height:60px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .18s}.ds-tabs button:first-child{padding-left:0}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--ink,#171918)}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]:after{content:"";position:absolute;height:3px;background:var(--ink,#171918);left:20px;right:20px;bottom:-2px}.ds-tabs button:first-child[aria-selected=true]:after{left:0}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:#111}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-text:focus-visible,.ds-tabs button:focus-visible,.ds-segment button:focus-visible,.ds-select:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69785e;outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview:
This is a presentation-scoped record of the built Say My Day HTML deck. Its warm paper, actual wordmark and notebook-carrying bird inherit the application's identity. These rules apply inside this presentation and do not establish or change the application's global system.

Large Korean statements, quiet source lines and actual product captures share a mostly flat paper surface. The demonstration and prompt narrative use dark surfaces. The illustrated diary supplies material warmth; controls remain compact and legible.
keyCharacteristics: Locally hosted Pretendard with large Korean headings.
Thin rules, selected-state ink and inspectable product evidence.
A fitted desktop stage that becomes a scrolling mobile page.

rules.name: The Surface Contrast Rule
rules.body: Preserve the implemented light text on dark narrative surfaces and ink text on paper; dark sections are whole surfaces, not colored text accents.

rules.name: The Korean Word Rule
rules.body: At the mobile breakpoint, Korean headings and prose keep words intact. Table cells, code and source lines may wrap anywhere; Chinese language spans use normal word breaking with overflow wrapping.

rules.name: The Reading Flow Rule
rules.body: Mobile is an active slide with vertical reading flow, never a miniature desktop canvas.

dos: Do retain the actual wordmark, bird and original product captures.
Do preserve selected, disabled and visible keyboard-focus states.
Do use normal mobile reading flow and keep Korean words intact.
Do keep these rules scoped to this presentation.
donts: Don't stretch portrait product evidence to fill a desktop column.
Don't apply the diary sheet's rotation and shadow to ordinary controls or evidence tables.
Don't treat a sampled contextual type size as a mandatory size for every paragraph.
